description: Source code for the FrontPanel plugin implementation, managing initialization, deinitialization, and information retrieval for front panel LEDs control in a device.

classes.name: Plugin::FrontPanel
classes.description: Class managing front panel LED controls, including initialization, deinitialization, and status reporting.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the front panel plugin, sets up connections, and registers the front panel interface.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters the front panel, and terminates remote connections.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns a string describing the purpose and capabilities of the front panel plugin.
